question: 8 cm and 5 cm are the radii of two circles. If the distance between the centres of the two circles is 11 cm, then the length (in cm) of the common tangent of two circles is:
solution:
Formula used:

Direct common tangent = √ (distance between the two centers2 - ( r1 - r2)2

Calculation: 

Direct common tangent = D

Distance between the two centers is = 11 cm

As per the formula,

D = √ (112 - ( 8 - 5)2.

⇒ √ (121 - 9)

⇒ √112
